description: This file defines a utility class 'PasswordHash' for handling password hashing and verification in the OrangeHRM system. It wraps PHP's built-in password_hash and password_verify functions, specifying the use of bcrypt with a specified cost.

classes.name: PasswordHash
classes.description: A utility class for creating and verifying password hashes using bcrypt.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Generates a bcrypt hash of a given password.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a password against a given hash.
